tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
D CORE 2U 19-Inch X22RM Heavy-Duty Silver Black Rack Mount Case


The D CORE 2U 19-inch X22RM Heavy-Duty Rack Mount Case is a compact and robust server chassis designed for professional IT, networking, and industrial applications. Built to fit standard 19-inch server racks, this 2U rack mount case is ideal for space-efficient server builds, network appliances, NVR systems, and firewall solutions.

Manufactured with heavy-duty steel construction and finished in an elegant silver-black color, the X22RM ensures durability, stability, and long-term performance in continuous operation environments. Its optimized internal design supports efficient airflow, multiple storage options, and reliable component installation, making it suitable for enterprise and data-center use.

The front panel includes power and reset buttons with LED indicators for easy system monitoring and control. With support for standard server-grade components and full-width rack compatibility, the D CORE X22RM 2U rack mount case delivers professional quality and dependable performance.

Available from D CORE, this rack-mount chassis comes with local warranty and fast delivery across Bangladesh, making it an excellent choice for commercial, enterprise, and industrial deployments.
